text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega didn't come to training.
Searching for her whereabouts, I found her in the library.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to call out to her, I noticed she was nodding off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Um... while I was digging through racing materials,
before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, I will be more careful in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While worrying a bit about her tendency to never cut corners,
you firmly warned her to be careful next time.
